non_diegetic_music: A sparse sustained string pad at slow tempo, joined by a single low piano note, fading gently at the end.
overall_soundscape: Wind moves steadily through the pine branches. Snow settles from a bough with a soft collapse, and a distant raven calls twice.

shots.description: A wide shot frames a snow-covered pine forest at dawn. Low mist drifts between the trees and soft golden light reaches the upper branches.
